scope: Targeted primary-source novelty audit, separate from 300-record title/category screen

sources.title: Look Again Before You Abstain: Budgeted Conformal Evidence Acquisition for Reliable Vision-Language Models
sources.project_relevance: Crops, claim-type interventions, post-acquisition calibration already studied; very close collision for adaptive abstention.

sources.title: Towards Statistical Factuality Guarantee for Large Vision-Language Models
sources.project_relevance: Conformal claim filtering with general, medical, document applications.

sources.title: Learning Conformal Abstention Policies for Adaptive Risk Management in Large Language and Vision-Language Models
sources.project_relevance: Per-instance conformal abstention policy; broad abstention novelty collision.

sources.title: Fine-Grained Multi-Image Object Hallucination Benchmark
sources.project_relevance: Fine-grained multi-image tasks and pressures; number of images, perceptual difficulty, contextual bias.

sources.title: MIHBench: Benchmarking and Mitigating Multi-Image Hallucinations in Multimodal Large Language Models
sources.project_relevance: Existence, counting, identity consistency and dynamic attention balancing.

sources.title: Identifying and Mitigating Position Bias of Multi-image Vision-Language Models
sources.project_relevance: Position bias; training-free interpolation toward bidirectional inter-image attention.

sources.title: Enhancing Multi-Image Understanding through Delimiter Token Scaling
sources.project_relevance: Image separation through delimiter hidden-state scaling; low-cost comparator.

sources.title: Looking Back and Forth: Cross-Image Attention Calibration and Attentive Preference Learning for Multi-Image Hallucination Mitigation
sources.project_relevance: Selective inter-image attention plus preference learning; fixed mask mixing and alternating layer strategy.

sources.title: CGC: Compositional Grounded Contrast for Fine-Grained Multi-Image Understanding
sources.project_relevance: Source-aware grounding, correlated crops, object constancy already used for GRPO.

sources.title: Mitigating Cross-Image Information Leakage in LVLMs for Multi-Image Tasks
sources.project_relevance: Training-free architecture-agnostic focused decoding; source isolation comparator.

sources.title: Revealing Multi-View Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models
sources.project_relevance: Cross-view/cross-instance benchmark and contrastive text-attention masking.

sources.title: AVAM: Universal Training-free Adaptive Visual Anchoring Embedded into Multimodal Large Language Model for Multi-image Question Answering
sources.project_relevance: Adaptive contiguous visual compression and collaborative decoding; adaptive selection comparator.

sources.title: Knowing When Not to Answer: Evaluating Abstention in Multimodal Reasoning Systems
sources.project_relevance: Matched evidence sufficiency and modality dependency transformations; degraded/contradictory evidence failure.

sources.title: TRAPSBench: Vision-Language Models Encode but Fail to Express Epistemic Restraint
sources.project_relevance: Matched physics video pairs, answerability probes and activation steering already studied.

sources.title: Bigger or Cheaper? Scale and Quantization Effects on Uncertainty Signals in Vision-Language Models Under Image Degradation
sources.project_relevance: Direct collision for generic quantization-confidence study.

sources.title: BEFORE THE FLIP: Measuring Hidden Score Shifts In Quantized Vision Language Models Before The Answer Changes for Visual Question Answering
sources.project_relevance: Direct collision for quantization-induced latent grounding shifts; reports no robust gain from question-specific bit allocation.

sources.title: Hacking Hallucinations of MLLMs with Causal Sufficiency and Necessity
sources.project_relevance: Causal sufficiency/necessity of inference tokens for GRPO; no broad novelty for these concepts.

sources.title: Treble Counterfactual VLMs: A Causal Approach to Hallucination
sources.project_relevance: Modality-specific and cross-modal causal interventions; generic visual ablation is crowded.

sources.title: Does Playing it Safe Count as Faithfulness? Reassessing LVLM Hallucination Mitigation Methods
sources.project_relevance: Hallucination reductions can reflect less informative responses; broad informativeness critique already exists.

sources.title: TruthLens: Object Hallucination Detection via Self-Evaluating Truthfulness Scores in LVLMs
sources.project_relevance: Special-token truthfulness signal and small fine-tuning; not novel to expose latent correctness.

sources.title: HALP: Detecting Hallucinations in Vision-Language Models without Generating a Single Token
sources.project_relevance: Single-pass pre-generation hallucination probes; broad cheap detector idea already done.

sources.title: VL-Calibration: Decoupled Confidence Calibration for Large Vision-Language Models Reasoning
sources.project_relevance: Separate visual/reasoning confidence, perturbation KL plus token entropy; direct confidence decomposition collision.

sources.title: VLMs Need Words: Vision Language Models Ignore Visual Detail In Favor of Semantic Anchors
sources.project_relevance: Semantic names/arbitrary anchors help fine-grained perception; naming-based method already studied.

sources.title: More Images, More Problems? A Controlled Analysis of VLM Failure Modes.
sources.project_relevance: Already controls image count versus sequence length and information spread; masking late inter-image attention and procedural training.

sources.title: Utility-Oriented Visual Evidence Selection for Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation
sources.project_relevance: Training-free lightweight utility selector; essential comparator for evidence selection.

sources.title: Counting Copies as Evidence: Confidence Inflation from Dependent Evidence in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
sources.project_relevance: Direct conceptual prior on provenance and confidence inflation. Position paper proposing research agenda, not a completed empirical VLM result.

sources.title: Natural Language for Visual Reasoning / NLVR2 official data
sources.project_relevance: Natural photographs with compositional quantified statements; image access may require form.

sources.title: COCO official dataset
sources.project_relevance: Existing object annotations support cheap controlled galleries; absence labels require manual checks.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct
sources.project_relevance: Compact open local baseline with multi-image inputs.

sources.title: Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct
sources.project_relevance: More recent compact open baseline; cross-family replication still required.
